superiority_reason: Synthetic custom likelihood-informed track, one generation; no global-best/equal-research-effort claim
description: Laplace-preconditioned Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for ten distinct logistic-GLM posteriors. Each observation gets its own MAP/Hessian whitening transform and independently evolved chain. The sampler uses exact supplied full prior precision, Metropolis correction, randomized trajectory lengths, 1,200 warm-up iterations, dual-averaging step-size tuning for the first 900 iterations, and deterministic per-observation RNG streams derived from the seed. Draw order is deterministically shuffled after sampling; no diagonal approximation is imposed.
